title: This interactive 3D gristmill was built using Claude Opus 5.5
caption:
This interactive 3D gristmill simulation was built using Claude Opus 5.5.

The clip shows an overshot watermill with water flowing through it and live engineering specs on screen.
Anthropic highlighted it as one of several inventive Claude builds from recent weeks.
A separate creator also published a growing gallery of 226 motion graphics all made with Opus 5.5.

Video: thebuggeddev on X
